## Standing operator rules
Goal for this session: replace the hand-rolled retry loop in ledgerly/sync/client.py with tenacity.

Every added Python dependency must include a security-exception.md entry countersigned by @omar before CI may pass.

Adding a covering index on invoices(customer_id, created_at) was tried for the slow report; it doubled write latency on the ingest path. Ruled out.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

Production credential rotation steps 2–8 remain required in order, one at a time: record lease, mint credential, update secret, restart deployment, verify startup, revoke old lease, and remove temporary files.

Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Recent work
The tenacity refactor was stopped; reconciliation refund double-counting is now the priority. CLI billing-filter deduplication and focused tests passed. Latest focused output: `1 passed, 0 failed in 0.12 seconds`. Webhook delivery code is in `ledgerly/webhooks.py`, with tests in `tests/test_webhooks.py`.
